club_message_policies.name: group_msg_insert
club_message_policies.with_check:
((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM social_group_members m
  WHERE ((m.group_id = social_group_messages.group_id) AND (m.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (m.status = 'accepted'::text)))))

club_message_policies.name: group_msg_read
club_message_policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM social_group_members m
  WHERE ((m.group_id = social_group_messages.group_id) AND (m.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (m.status = 'accepted'::text))))
